zpankz/mcp-skillset/skill-creator.descriptionCn: 创建有效技能的指南。当用户想要创建新技能（或更新现有技能）以通过专业知识、工作流程或工具集成扩展 Claude 的功能时，应使用此技能。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/skill-discovery.title: skill-discovery
zpankz/mcp-skillset/skill-discovery.description: Discover and search 36,500+ skills via progressive Markov-chain traversal of semantic search hypergraphs. Use when (1) Users ask to find/search/discover skills or capabilities, (2) Users describe a task/problem needing specialized skills, (3) Users ask "what skills exist" or "show me skills for X", (4) Users want to explore or browse available skills, (5) Users ask meta-questions about skill discovery itself ("how do I find skills?"), or (6) No specific skill matches the user's need and discovery is appropriate
zpankz/mcp-skillset/skill-discovery.descriptionEn: Discover and search 36,500+ skills via progressive Markov-chain traversal of semantic search hypergraphs. Use when (1) Users ask to find/search/discover skills or capabilities, (2) Users describe a task/problem needing specialized skills, (3) Users ask "what skills exist" or "show me skills for X", (4) Users want to explore or browse available skills, (5) Users ask meta-questions about skill discovery itself ("how do I find skills?"), or (6) No specific skill matches the user's need and discovery is appropriate
zpankz/mcp-skillset/skill-discovery.descriptionCn: 通过语义搜索超图的渐进马尔可夫链遍历发现和搜索 36,500 多种技能。在以下情况下使用：(1) 用户要求查找/搜索/发现技能或能力，(2) 用户描述需要专门技能的任务/问题，(3) 用户询问“存在哪些技能”或“显示 X 的技能”，(4) 用户想要探索或浏览可用技能，(5) 用户询问有关技能发现本身的元问题（“我如何找到技能？”），或 (6) 没有特定技能符合用户的需求且发现是适当的

zpankz/mcp-skillset/skill-rag-router.title: skill-rag-router
zpankz/mcp-skillset/skill-rag-router.description: Semantic skill discovery and routing using GraphRAG, vector embeddings, and multi-tool search. Automatically matches user intent to the most relevant skills from 144+ available options using ck semantic search, LEANN RAG, and knowledge graph relationships. Triggers on /meta queries, complex multi-domain tasks, explicit skill requests, or when task complexity exceeds threshold (files>20, domains>2, complexity>=0.7).

zpankz/mcp-skillset/skill-rag-router.descriptionCn: 使用 GraphRAG、向量嵌入和多工具搜索进行语义技能发现和路由。使用 ck 语义搜索、LEANN RAG 和知识图关系，自动将用户意图与 144 多个可用选项中最相关的技能进行匹配。在/元查询、复杂的多域任务、明确的技能请求或任务复杂性超过阈值（文件>20、域>2、复杂性>=0.7）时触发。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/skills-router.title: skills-router
zpankz/mcp-skillset/skills-router.description: Routes tasks to skills in skill-db and skill-library using semantic discovery. Triggers on specialized skill requirements, domain-specific tasks, or explicit skill requests. Uses skill-discovery, mcp-skillset, and skill-rag-router for semantic matching.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/skills-router.descriptionEn: Routes tasks to skills in skill-db and skill-library using semantic discovery. Triggers on specialized skill requirements, domain-specific tasks, or explicit skill requests. Uses skill-discovery, mcp-skillset, and skill-rag-router for semantic matching.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/skills-router.descriptionCn: 使用语义发现将任务路由到技能数据库和技能库中的技能。触发专门技能要求、特定领域任务或明确的技能请求。使用技能发现、mcp-skillset 和技能-rag-router 进行语义匹配。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/software-architectur.title: software-architecture
zpankz/mcp-skillset/software-architectur.description: Guide for quality focused software architecture. This skill should be used when users want to write code, design architecture, analyze code, in any case that relates to software development.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/software-architectur.descriptionEn: Guide for quality focused software architecture. This skill should be used when users want to write code, design architecture, analyze code, in any case that relates to software development.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/software-architectur.descriptionCn: 以质量为中心的软件架构指南。当用户想要编写代码、设计架构、分析代码时，在任何与软件开发相关的情况下，都应该使用这项技能。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/spec-writer.title: spec-writer
zpankz/mcp-skillset/spec-writer.description: This skill should be used when writing technical specifications, architecture documents, or design proposals that require structured analysis, clear documentation, and actionable implementation plans.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/spec-writer.descriptionEn: This skill should be used when writing technical specifications, architecture documents, or design proposals that require structured analysis, clear documentation, and actionable implementation plans.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/spec-writer.descriptionCn: 在编写需要结构化分析、清晰的文档和可操作的实施计划的技术规范、架构文档或设计提案时，应该使用此技能。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/subagent-driven-deve.title: subagent-driven-development
zpankz/mcp-skillset/subagent-driven-deve.description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session or facing 3+ independent issues that can be investigated without shared state or dependencies - dispatches fresh subagent for each task with code review between tasks, enabling fast iteration with quality gates
zpankz/mcp-skillset/subagent-driven-deve.descriptionEn: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session or facing 3+ independent issues that can be investigated without shared state or dependencies - dispatches fresh subagent for each task with code review between tasks, enabling fast iteration with quality gates
zpankz/mcp-skillset/subagent-driven-deve.descriptionCn: 在当前会话中执行具有独立任务的实施计划或面临 3 个以上独立问题时使用，这些问题可以在没有共享状态或依赖关系的情况下进行调查 - 为每个任务分派新的子代理，并在任务之间进行代码审查，从而通过质量门实现快速迭代

zpankz/mcp-skillset/subagent-prompt-cons.title: subagent-prompt-construction
zpankz/mcp-skillset/subagent-prompt-cons.description: Systematic methodology for constructing compact (<150 lines), expressive, Claude Code-integrated subagent prompts using lambda contracts and symbolic logic. Use when creating new specialized subagents for Claude Code with agent composition, MCP tool integration, or skill references. Validated with phase-planner-executor (V_instance=0.895).
zpankz/mcp-skillset/subagent-prompt-cons.descriptionEn: Systematic methodology for constructing compact (<150 lines), expressive, Claude Code-integrated subagent prompts using lambda contracts and symbolic logic. Use when creating new specialized subagents for Claude Code with agent composition, MCP tool integration, or skill references. Validated with phase-planner-executor (V_instance=0.895).
zpankz/mcp-skillset/subagent-prompt-cons.descriptionCn: 使用 lambda 契约和符号逻辑构建紧凑（<150 行）、富有表现力、Claude 代码集成的子代理提示的系统方法。在通过代理组合、MCP 工具集成或技能参考为 Claude Code 创建新的专用子代理时使用。使用阶段规划器执行器进行验证（V_instance=0.895）。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/suno-song.title: suno-song
zpankz/mcp-skillset/suno-song.description: Transform diverse inputs (YouTube videos/audio, existing Suno songs, raw lyrics, audio files, or conversational ideas) into highly optimized Suno V5 custom song generation prompts with intelligent character optimization (5000 lyrics, 1000 style limits), proven metatag reliability, V5-enhanced emotion tags, and template-based best practices. Use when user wants to create music with Suno, provides content for song generation, or needs help crafting effective V5 prompts.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/suno-song.descriptionEn: Transform diverse inputs (YouTube videos/audio, existing Suno songs, raw lyrics, audio files, or conversational ideas) into highly optimized Suno V5 custom song generation prompts with intelligent character optimization (5000 lyrics, 1000 style limits), proven metatag reliability, V5-enhanced emotion tags, and template-based best practices. Use when user wants to create music with Suno, provides content for song generation, or needs help crafting effective V5 prompts.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/suno-song.descriptionCn: 通过智能字符优化（5000 句歌词、1000 种风格限制）、经过验证的元标签可靠性、V5 增强型情感标签和基于模板的最佳实践，将各种输入（YouTube 视频/音频、现有 Suno 歌曲、原始歌词、音频文件或对话想法）转换为高度优化的 Suno V5 自定义歌曲生成提示。当用户想要使用 Suno 创建音乐、提供歌曲生成内容或需要帮助制作有效的 V5 提示时使用。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/tapestry.title: tapestry
zpankz/mcp-skillset/tapestry.description: Unified content extraction and action planning. Use when user says `tapestry [URL]`, `weave [URL]`, `help me plan [URL]`, `extract and plan [URL]`, `make this actionable [URL]`, or similar phrases indicating they want to extract content and create an action plan. Automatically detects content type (YouTube video, article, PDF) and processes accordingly.

zpankz/mcp-skillset/tapestry.descriptionCn: 统一的内容提取和行动规划。当用户说“tapestry [URL]”、“weave [URL]”、“help me plan [URL]”、“extract and plan [URL]”、“make this actionable [URL]”或类似短语表示他们想要提取内容并创建行动计划时使用。自动检测内容类型（YouTube 视频、文章、PDF）并进行相应处理。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/technical-debt-manag.title: Technical Debt Management
zpankz/mcp-skillset/technical-debt-manag.description: Systematic technical debt quantification and management using SQALE methodology with value-effort prioritization, phased paydown roadmaps, and prevention strategies. Use when technical debt unmeasured or subjective, need objective prioritization, planning refactoring work, establishing debt prevention practices, or tracking debt trends over time. Provides 6 methodology components (measurement with SQALE index, categorization with code smell taxonomy, prioritization with value-effort matrix, phased paydown roadmap, trend tracking system, prevention guidelines), 3 patterns (SQALE-based quantification, code smell taxonomy mapping, value-effort prioritization), 3 principles (high-value low-effort first, SQALE provides objective baseline, complexity drives maintainability debt). Validated with 4.5x speedup vs manual approach, 85% transferability across languages (Go, Python, JavaScript, Java, Rust), SQALE industry-standard methodology.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/technical-debt-manag.descriptionEn: Systematic technical debt quantification and management using SQALE methodology with value-effort prioritization, phased paydown roadmaps, and prevention strategies. Use when technical debt unmeasured or subjective, need objective prioritization, planning refactoring work, establishing debt prevention practices, or tracking debt trends over time. Provides 6 methodology components (measurement with SQALE index, categorization with code smell taxonomy, prioritization with value-effort matrix, phased paydown roadmap, trend tracking system, prevention guidelines), 3 patterns (SQALE-based quantification, code smell taxonomy mapping, value-effort prioritization), 3 principles (high-value low-effort first, SQALE provides objective baseline, complexity drives maintainability debt). Validated with 4.5x speedup vs manual approach, 85% transferability across languages (Go, Python, JavaScript, Java, Rust), SQALE industry-standard methodology.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/technical-debt-manag.descriptionCn: 使用 SQALE 方法进行系统性技术债务量化和管理，并确定价值努力优先级、分阶段还款路线图和预防策略。当技术债务无法衡量或主观、需要客观优先级、规划重构工作、建立债务预防实践或跟踪一段时间内的债务趋势时使用。提供 6 个方法组件（使用 SQALE 指数进行测量、使用代码异味分类法进行分类、使用价值-努力矩阵进行优先级排序、分阶段支付路线图、趋势跟踪系统、预防指南）、3 个模式（基于 SQALE 的量化、代码异味分类映射、价值-努力优先级排序）、3 个原则（高价值低努力优先、SQALE 提供客观基线、复杂性驱动可维护性债务）。经过验证，与手动方法相比，速度提高了 4.5 倍，跨语言（Go、Python、JavaScript、Java、Rust）的可移植性达到 85%，SQALE 行业标准方法。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/telos.title: telos
zpankz/mcp-skillset/telos.description: Teleological physiology analysis framework for understanding biological systems through multi-constraint optimization. Use when analyzing physiological mechanisms, explaining apparent biological "inefficiencies", preparing for medical examinations (CICM/ANZCA Primary), understanding why biological systems are designed the way they are, or when seeking deeper mechanistic understanding beyond descriptive knowledge. Triggers on questions like "why is X designed this way", "what purpose does Y serve", "how is Z optimized", analysis of physiological trade-offs, or exploration of evolutionary/design constraints.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/telos.descriptionEn: Teleological physiology analysis framework for understanding biological systems through multi-constraint optimization. Use when analyzing physiological mechanisms, explaining apparent biological "inefficiencies", preparing for medical examinations (CICM/ANZCA Primary), understanding why biological systems are designed the way they are, or when seeking deeper mechanistic understanding beyond descriptive knowledge. Triggers on questions like "why is X designed this way", "what purpose does Y serve", "how is Z optimized", analysis of physiological trade-offs, or exploration of evolutionary/design constraints.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/telos.descriptionCn: 通过多约束优化来理解生物系统的目的生理学分析框架。在分析生理机制、解释明显的生物“低效率”、准备医学检查（CICM/ANZCA Primary）、理解生物系统为何如此设计或在描述性知识之外寻求更深入的机械理解时使用。触发诸如“为什么 X 如此设计”、“Y 的用途是什么”、“Z 如何优化”、生理权衡分析或进化/设计约束探索等问题。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/test-driven-developm.title: test-driven-development
zpankz/mcp-skillset/test-driven-developm.description: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code - write the test first, watch it fail, write minimal code to pass; ensures tests actually verify behavior by requiring failure first
zpankz/mcp-skillset/test-driven-developm.descriptionEn: Use when implementing any feature or bugfix, before writing implementation code - write the test first, watch it fail, write minimal code to pass; ensures tests actually verify behavior by requiring failure first

zpankz/mcp-skillset/testing-strategy.title: Testing Strategy
zpankz/mcp-skillset/testing-strategy.description: Systematic testing methodology for Go projects using TDD, coverage-driven gap closure, fixture patterns, and CLI testing. Use when establishing test strategy from scratch, improving test coverage from 60-75% to 80%+, creating test infrastructure with mocks and fixtures, building CLI test suites, or systematizing ad-hoc testing. Provides 8 documented patterns (table-driven, golden file, fixture, mocking, CLI testing, integration, helper utilities, coverage-driven gap closure), 3 automation tools (coverage analyzer 186x speedup, test generator 200x speedup, methodology guide 7.5x speedup). Validated across 3 project archetypes with 3.1x average speedup, 5.8% adaptation effort, 89% transferability to Python/Rust/TypeScript.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/testing-strategy.descriptionEn: Systematic testing methodology for Go projects using TDD, coverage-driven gap closure, fixture patterns, and CLI testing. Use when establishing test strategy from scratch, improving test coverage from 60-75% to 80%+, creating test infrastructure with mocks and fixtures, building CLI test suites, or systematizing ad-hoc testing. Provides 8 documented patterns (table-driven, golden file, fixture, mocking, CLI testing, integration, helper utilities, coverage-driven gap closure), 3 automation tools (coverage analyzer 186x speedup, test generator 200x speedup, methodology guide 7.5x speedup). Validated across 3 project archetypes with 3.1x average speedup, 5.8% adaptation effort, 89% transferability to Python/Rust/TypeScript.
zpankz/mcp-skillset/testing-strategy.descriptionCn: 使用 TDD、覆盖驱动的间隙闭合、夹具模式和 CLI 测试的 Go 项目的系统测试方法。在从头开始建立测试策略、将测试覆盖率从 60-75% 提高到 80% 以上、使用模拟和固定装置创建测试基础设施、构建 CLI 测试套件或系统化临时测试时使用。提供 8 个记录模式（表驱动、黄金文件、夹具、模拟、CLI 测试、集成、辅助实用程序、覆盖率驱动的差距闭合）、3 个自动化工具（覆盖率分析器 186 倍加速、测试生成器 200 倍加速、方法指南 7.5 倍加速）。在 3 个项目原型中进行了验证，平均加速率为 3.1 倍，适应工作量为 5.8%，Python/Rust/TypeScript 的可迁移性为 89%。

zpankz/mcp-skillset/textbook-grounding.title: textbook-grounding

zrt-ai-lab/opencode-skills/log-analyzer.title: log-analyzer
zrt-ai-lab/opencode-skills/log-analyzer.description: 全维度日志分析技能。自动识别日志类型（Java应用/MySQL Binlog/Nginx/Trace/告警），提取关键实体（IP、thread_id、trace_id、用户、表名等），进行根因定位、告警分析、异常洞察。支持100M+大文件。触发词：分析日志、日志排查、根因定位、告警分析、异常分析。
zrt-ai-lab/opencode-skills/log-analyzer.descriptionEn: 全维度日志分析技能。自动识别日志类型（Java应用/MySQL Binlog/Nginx/Trace/告警），提取关键实体（IP、thread_id、trace_id、用户、表名等），进行根因定位、告警分析、异常洞察。支持100M+大文件。触发词：分析日志、日志排查、根因定位、告警分析、异常分析。
zrt-ai-lab/opencode-skills/log-analyzer.descriptionCn: 全面的日志分析功能。自动识别日志类型（Java应用程序/MySQL Binlog/Nginx/Trace/Alerts），提取关键实体（IP、thread_id、trace_id、用户、表名等），进行根本原因分析、警报分析和异常检测。支持超过 100 MB 的文件。触发词：分析日志、日志故障排除、根本原因分析、警报分析、异常分析。

zscole/model-hierarchy-skill/model-hiera.title: model-hierarchy
zscole/model-hierarchy-skill/model-hiera.description: Cost-optimize AI agent operations by routing tasks to appropriate models based on complexity. Use this skill when: (1) deciding which model to use for a task, (2) spawning sub-agents, (3) considering cost efficiency, (4) the current model feels like overkill for the task. Triggers: "model routing", "cost optimization", "which model", "too expensive", "spawn agent".
zscole/model-hierarchy-skill/model-hiera.descriptionEn: Cost-optimize AI agent operations by routing tasks to appropriate models based on complexity. Use this skill when: (1) deciding which model to use for a task, (2) spawning sub-agents, (3) considering cost efficiency, (4) the current model feels like overkill for the task. Triggers: "model routing", "cost optimization", "which model", "too expensive", "spawn agent".
zscole/model-hierarchy-skill/model-hiera.descriptionCn: 根据复杂性将任务路由到适当的模型，从而优化 AI 代理操作的成本。在以下情况下使用此技能：(1) 决定对任务使用哪个模型，(2) 生成子代理，(3) 考虑成本效率，(4) 当前模型对于任务来说有点大材小用。触发器：“模型路由”、“成本优化”、“哪个模型”、“太贵”、“生成代理”。
